reference.source: BEIR BM25 (Anserini, k1 0.9, b 0.4, title and text fields)

notes: One abstract per memory as '<title>. <text>' (BEIR indexes two fields); k 100, no token budget; English only. Known gap: served bm25 measures below BEIR's published 0.325 and Pyserini's single-field 0.322; the offline textbook BM25 over the same memories measures 0.318, so most of the gap is the one-body mapping and the analyser (Snowball against Lucene's Porter, hyphenated words kept whole), not the ranking (ADR-0049 d12). bm25's list reranked by ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2 through candle on the CPU at depth 20 (the default became 10 after this run), with a cap of 8 and a 60 s deadline so no rerank was skipped; the host carried a load average of 9 to 29 from other work, and the LoCoMo run shared it with the NFCorpus run, so its latency is an upper bound (ADR-0053 d4, FR-88).
